1011	#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
1012	async fn run_acp_episode(
1013	    root: &Path,
1014	    snapshot: &sea_forge_agent::EndpointSnapshot,
1015	    bundle: &AuthorityPolicyBundle,
1016	    entity: &str,
1017	    process: &str,
1018	    run: &str,
1019	    case: &str,
1020	    item: &str,
1021	    instruction: &str,
1022	    max_turns: u32,
1023	    cancel: impl Fn() -> bool + Send + Sync + 'static,
1024	    permission_broker: Option<AcpApprovalBroker>,
1025	    criteria: sea_forge_core::types::SettlementCriteriaRecord,
1026	    criteria_ref: sea_forge_ledger::CommittedRecordRef,
1027	    sandbox_class: &str,
1028	) -> Result<
1029	    (
1030	        sea_forge_agent::DelegationOutcome,
1031	        Option<String>,
1032	        Vec<String>,
1033	    ),
1034	    ForgeError,
1035	> {
1036	    let argv: Vec<String> = snapshot.argv.clone();
1037	    if argv.is_empty() {
1038	        return Err(ForgeError::Config {
1039	            class: "schema_error",
1040	            path: root.join("server.yaml"),
1041	            message: "acp endpoint argv is empty".into(),
1042	        });
1043	    }
1044	    let env_pairs: Vec<(String, String)> = snapshot
1045	        .env
1046	        .iter()
1047	        .filter_map(|e| {
1048	            e.split_once('=')
1049	                .map(|(k, v)| (k.to_string(), v.to_string()))
1050	        })
1051	        .filter(|(key, _)| !key.starts_with("SEA_FORGE_SWE_SEED_"))
1052	        .collect();
1053	    let workspace = root.join("runs").join(run).join("workspace");
1054	    std::fs::create_dir_all(&workspace).map_err(|e| ForgeError::io("create acp workspace", e))?;
1055	    let spawn = AcpSpawn {
1056	        argv,
1057	        env: env_pairs,
1058	        cwd: Some(workspace.clone()),
1059	        max_response_bytes: snapshot.max_response_bytes,
1060	        max_transcript_bytes: snapshot
1061	            .max_request_bytes
1062	            .saturating_add(snapshot.max_response_bytes),
1063	    };
1064	    let session = match sandbox_class {
1065	        "local" => AcpSession::spawn(spawn)
1066	            .map(|(session, _)| session)
1067	            .map_err(|message| ForgeError::Config {
1068	                class: "agent_endpoint_error",
1069	                path: root.join("server.yaml"),
1070	                message,
1071	            })?,
1072	        "jail" => {
1073	            let artifacts = root.join("runs").join(run).join("artifacts");
1074	            std::fs::create_dir_all(&artifacts)
1075	                .map_err(|error| ForgeError::io("create ACP artifacts", error))?;
1076	            let workspace_for_jail = workspace.clone();
1077	            let argv = spawn.argv.clone();
1078	            let env = spawn.env.clone();
1079	            let (sender, receiver) = std::sync::mpsc::channel();
1080	            std::thread::spawn(move || {
1081	                // Jail-class ACP agents default to network denial (fail-closed).
1082	                // No scoped egress grant is plumbed to this path yet; the jail
1083	                // must not open ungranted outbound/listening TCP sockets.
1084	                let result = sea_forge_sandbox::jail::spawn_interactive(
1085	                    &workspace_for_jail,
1086	                    &artifacts,
1087	                    &argv,
1088	                    &workspace_for_jail,
1089	                    &env,
1090	                    &sea_forge_sandbox::NetworkPosture::Denied,
1091	                );
1092	                let _ = sender.send(result);
1093	            });
1094	            let child = receiver
1095	                .recv()
1096	                .map_err(|error| ForgeError::Internal(error.to_string()))??;
1097	            AcpSession::from_std_child(
1098	                child.child,
1099	                child.stdin,
1100	                child.stdout,
1101	                child.stderr,
1102	                workspace.clone(),
1103	                snapshot.max_response_bytes,
1104	                snapshot
1105	                    .max_request_bytes
1106	                    .saturating_add(snapshot.max_response_bytes),
1107	            )
1108	            .map_err(ForgeError::Internal)?
1109	        }
1110	        other => {
1111	            return Err(ForgeError::Config {
1112	                class: "unsupported_sandbox_class_error",
1113	                path: root.join("server.yaml"),
1114	                message: format!("ACP sandbox class '{other}' is unavailable"),
1115	            });
1116	        }
1117	    };
1118	    let mediator = AcpAuthorityMediator {
1119	        root: root.to_path_buf(),
1120	        case_id: case.into(),
1121	        run_id: run.into(),
1122	        item_id: item.into(),
1123	        entity: entity.into(),
1124	        process: process.into(),
1125	        bundle: Arc::new(bundle.clone()),
1126	        timeout_secs: snapshot.timeout.as_secs(),
1127	        decision_sequence: Arc::new(std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize::new(3)),
1128	        permission_broker,
1129	        criteria,
1130	        criteria_ref,
1131	    };
1132	    let per_turn = snapshot.timeout;
1133	    let prior_continuation = latest_disconnected_continuation(root, case, item, &snapshot.id)?;
1134	    let acp_outcome = session
1135	        .run_episode_with_continuation(
1136	            instruction,
1137	            max_turns,
1138	            per_turn,
1139	            cancel,
1140	            &mediator,
1141	            prior_continuation.as_deref(),
1142	        )
1143	        .await;
1144	    let continuation_key = acp_outcome.continuation_key.clone();
1145	    let mut outcome = acp_outcome_to_delegation(acp_outcome);
1146	    let harvested = match harvest_swe_seed(snapshot, &workspace, run) {
1147	        Ok(refs) => refs,
1148	        Err(_) => {
1149	            outcome.termination = DelegationTermination::EndpointError;
1150	            outcome.error_subcode = Some("swe_seed_harvest_error".into());
1151	            Vec::new()
1152	        }
1153	    };
1154	    Ok((outcome, continuation_key, harvested))
1155	}

1157	fn harvest_swe_seed(
1158	    snapshot: &sea_forge_agent::EndpointSnapshot,
1159	    workspace: &Path,
1160	    run: &str,
1161	) -> Result<Vec<String>, ForgeError> {
1162	    let configured = |key: &str| {
1163	        snapshot.env.iter().find_map(|entry| {
1164	            entry
1165	                .split_once('=')
1166	                .filter(|(name, _)| *name == key)
1167	                .map(|(_, value)| value.to_string())
1168	        })
1169	    };
1170	    let repo = configured("SEA_FORGE_SWE_SEED_REPO");
1171	    let expected_commit = configured("SEA_FORGE_SWE_SEED_COMMIT");
1172	    match (&repo, &expected_commit) {
1173	        (None, None) => return Ok(Vec::new()),
1174	        (Some(_), Some(_)) => {}
1175	        _ => {
1176	            return Err(ForgeError::Input(
1177	                "SWE_SEED repo and commit must be configured together".into(),
1178	            ));
1179	        }
1180	    }
1181	    let repo = std::fs::canonicalize(repo.unwrap())
1182	        .map_err(|error| ForgeError::io("canonicalize SWE_SEED repo", error))?;
1183	    let output = std::process::Command::new("git")
1184	        .args(["rev-parse", "HEAD"])
1185	        .current_dir(&repo)
1186	        .stdin(std::process::Stdio::null())
1187	        .stderr(std::process::Stdio::piped())
1188	        .output()
1189	        .map_err(|error| ForgeError::io("verify SWE_SEED commit", error))?;
1190	    let actual = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string();
1191	    if !output.status.success() || actual != expected_commit.unwrap() {
1192	        return Err(ForgeError::Input("SWE_SEED commit mismatch".into()));
1193	    }
1194	
1195	    let harness = workspace.join(".agent-harness");
1196	    if !harness.is_dir() {
1197	        return Err(ForgeError::Input(
1198	            "configured SWE_SEED run produced no .agent-harness evidence".into(),
1199	        ));
1200	    }
1201	    let canonical_harness = std::fs::canonicalize(&harness)
1202	        .map_err(|error| ForgeError::io("canonicalize SWE_SEED harness", error))?;
1203	    let canonical_workspace = std::fs::canonicalize(workspace)
1204	        .map_err(|error| ForgeError::io("canonicalize ACP workspace", error))?;
1205	    let mut pending = vec![harness];
1206	    let mut files = Vec::new();
1207	    while let Some(path) = pending.pop() {
1208	        for entry in std::fs::read_dir(&path)
1209	            .map_err(|error| ForgeError::io("read SWE_SEED harness", error))?
1210	        {
1211	            let entry = entry.map_err(|error| ForgeError::io("read SWE_SEED entry", error))?;
1212	            let metadata = entry
1213	                .file_type()
1214	                .map_err(|error| ForgeError::io("read SWE_SEED entry type", error))?;
1215	            if metadata.is_symlink() {
1216	                return Err(ForgeError::UnsafePath(
1217	                    "SWE_SEED evidence may not contain symlinks".into(),
1218	                ));
1219	            }
1220	            if metadata.is_dir() {
1221	                pending.push(entry.path());
1222	            } else if metadata.is_file() {
1223	                files.push(entry.path());
1224	                if files.len() > 64 {
1225	                    return Err(ForgeError::Input(
1226	                        "SWE_SEED evidence exceeds 64 files".into(),
1227	                    ));
1228	                }
1229	            }
1230	        }
1231	    }
1232	    files.sort();
1233	    let mut refs = Vec::with_capacity(files.len());
1234	    for path in files {
1235	        let canonical = std::fs::canonicalize(&path)
1236	            .map_err(|error| ForgeError::io("canonicalize SWE_SEED evidence", error))?;
1237	        if !canonical.starts_with(&canonical_harness) {
1238	            return Err(ForgeError::UnsafePath(
1239	                "SWE_SEED evidence escaped .agent-harness".into(),
1240	            ));
1241	        }
1242	        let bytes = std::fs::read(&canonical)
1243	            .map_err(|error| ForgeError::io("read SWE_SEED evidence", error))?;
1244	        if bytes.len() > 1_048_576 {
1245	            return Err(ForgeError::Input(
1246	                "SWE_SEED evidence file exceeds 1 MiB".into(),
1247	            ));
1248	        }
1249	        let relative = canonical
1250	            .strip_prefix(&canonical_workspace)
1251	            .map_err(|_| ForgeError::UnsafePath("invalid SWE_SEED evidence path".into()))?;
1252	        refs.push(format!(
1253	            "{run}:{}:sha256:{:x}",
1254	            relative.to_string_lossy(),
1255	            Sha256::digest(&bytes)
1256	        ));
1257	    }
1258	    Ok(refs)
1259	}

1261	fn latest_disconnected_continuation(
1262	    root: &Path,
1263	    case: &str,
1264	    item: &str,
1265	    endpoint: &str,
1266	) -> Result<Option<String>, ForgeError> {
1267	    let ledger = LedgerStream::open(root, format!("case-{case}"), "sea-forge-agent")?;
1268	    let entries = ledger.read_entries()?;
1269	    for session in entries
1270	        .iter()
1271	        .rev()
1272	        .filter(|entry| entry.record_kind == "acp_session")
1273	    {
1274	        if session.payload["plan_item_id"].as_str() != Some(item)
1275	            || session.payload["endpoint_ref"].as_str() != Some(endpoint)
1276	        {
1277	            continue;
1278	        }
1279	        let Some(session_run) = session.payload["run_id"].as_str() else {
1280	            continue;
1281	        };
1282	        let disconnected = entries.iter().any(|entry| {
1283	            entry.record_kind == "settlement"
1284	                && entry.payload["run_id"].as_str() == Some(session_run)
1285	                && entry.payload["basis"]
1286	                    .as_array()
1287	                    .is_some_and(|basis| basis.iter().any(|value| value == "acp_disconnect"))
1288	        });
1289	        if disconnected {
1290	            return Ok(session.payload["continuation_key"]
1291	                .as_str()
1292	                .map(str::to_owned));
1293	        }
1294	    }
1295	    Ok(None)
1296	}
1297	/// Map an ACP driver outcome to the shared delegation outcome shape so the
1298	/// common evidence/settlement postamble treats HTTP and ACP uniformly.
1299	fn acp_outcome_to_delegation(
1300	    outcome: sea_forge_agent::AcpOutcome,
1301	) -> sea_forge_agent::DelegationOutcome {
1302	    let raw_entries: Vec<sea_forge_agent::TranscriptEntry> = outcome
1303	        .transcript
1304	        .iter()
1305	        .map(|(role, content)| sea_forge_agent::TranscriptEntry {
1306	            role: role.clone(),
1307	            content: content.clone(),
1308	        })
1309	        .collect();
1310	    // Route ACP through the SAME shared producer as HTTP: redact against the
1311	    // sentinel corpus, canonicalize, and hash the exact canonical bytes BEFORE
1312	    // any summary or artifact is derived. Previously ACP transcripts reached
1313	    // hashing/storage with no redaction at all.
1314	    let produced = sea_forge_agent::produce_transcript(&raw_entries, &[]);
1315	    let entries = produced.entries;
1316	    let sha = produced.sha256;
1317	    let tool_calls = entries.iter().filter(|e| e.role == "tool").count() as u32;
1318	    let final_excerpt = entries
1319	        .iter()
1320	        .rev()
1321	        .find(|e| e.role == "assistant")
1322	        .map(|e| {
1323	            if e.content.len() <= 200 {
1324	                e.content.clone()
1325	            } else {
1326	                // Respect char boundaries when truncating redacted UTF-8.
1327	                let mut end = 200;
1328	                while !e.content.is_char_boundary(end) {
1329	                    end -= 1;
1330	                }
1331	                format!("{}...", &e.content[..end])
1332	            }
1333	        })
1334	        .unwrap_or_default();
1335	    let termination = match outcome.termination {
1336	        sea_forge_agent::AcpTermination::Completed => DelegationTermination::Completed,
1337	        sea_forge_agent::AcpTermination::Cancelled => DelegationTermination::Cancelled,
1338	        sea_forge_agent::AcpTermination::Disconnect => DelegationTermination::AcpDisconnect,
1339	        sea_forge_agent::AcpTermination::EndpointError => DelegationTermination::EndpointError,
1340	        sea_forge_agent::AcpTermination::TurnCapExceeded => DelegationTermination::TurnCapExceeded,
1341	    };
1342	    let error_subcode = match outcome.termination {
1343	        sea_forge_agent::AcpTermination::Disconnect => Some("acp_disconnect".into()),
1344	        sea_forge_agent::AcpTermination::EndpointError => Some("acp_spawn_error".into()),
1345	        _ => None,
1346	    };
1347	    // The final output flows into the settlement result; redact it through the
1348	    // same corpus so a sentinel cannot leak via the result surface either.
1349	    let final_output = outcome.final_output.map(|text| {
1350	        sea_forge_agent::produce_transcript(
1351	            &[sea_forge_agent::TranscriptEntry {
1352	                role: "assistant".into(),
1353	                content: text,
1354	            }],
1355	            &[],
1356	        )
1357	        .entries
1358	        .swap_remove(0)
1359	        .content
1360	    });
1361	    sea_forge_agent::DelegationOutcome {
1362	        termination,
1363	        turns_used: outcome.turns_used,
1364	        final_output,
1365	        transcript_sha256: sha,
1366	        summary: TranscriptSummary {
1367	            turn_count: outcome.turns_used,
1368	            tool_calls,
1369	            final_excerpt,
1370	        },
1371	        transcript: entries,
1372	        error_subcode,
1373	    }
1374	}
